{{Quote|You will make transit to the next Belt inward, to the particular rock owned by Bohhuah Mutdah, and sell him the drug.|Administrator Senior Lob Doluff, to Lando Calrissian while on the Sixth Belt asteroid Oseon 6845|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
The '''Sixth Belt''' was one of the seven broad [[Oseon asteroid belt|bands]] of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] that constituted the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. It contained the asteroid [[Oseon 6845]], which was the largest [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] body in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was home to both the [[Oseon Administration]] and numerous luxurious [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]], night entertainment venues, and private residences. Each [[Local year|year]], the Oseon system, including the Sixth Belt, experienced the phenomenon known as the [[Flamewind of Oseon/Legends|Flamewind]], which affected both living beings and inadequately [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielded]] technological devices.

At some point between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the [[Sorcerers of Tund/Legends|sorcerer]] [[Rokur Gepta]] indirectly lured the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] to the Oseon system in order to exact vengeance upon him. Calrissian played the [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game on Oseon 6845 before becoming forced to [[Death/Legends|kill]] a [[Kenow|member]] of the [[Renatasian Confederation]], which had also arrived in the system while targeting Calrissian's [[Class Two multi-phasic robot|droid]] [[Pilot/Legends|copilot]], [[Vuffi Raa]].

Calrissian was placed under arrest, but the Oseon system's [[Administrator Senior]], [[Lob Doluff]], commuted the system's traditional capital punishment for carrying a lethal weapon in favor of forcing Calrissian to transport two [[Police officer/Legends|law enforcement officers]], [[Waywa Fybot]] and [[Bassi Vobah]], to the asteroid [[Oseon 5792]] and participate in a drug-related arrest there. During the ensuing Flamewind-affected journey through the Sixth Belt, Calrissian's [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|starship]] came under an attack by the Renatasian Confederation's [[Zero Squadron|squadron]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Calrissian was able to escape his pursuers, and his [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|ship]] subsequently left the Sixth Belt.

==Description==
===A belt of asteroids===
[[File:Oseon-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Sixth Belt lay in the Oseon system.]]
The Sixth Belt was one of the seven wide [[Oseon asteroid belt|bands]] of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Oseon sun|sun]] and made up the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]],<ref name="LCFO" /> a part of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Along with the rest of the Oseon [[Star system/Legends|system]], the [[Asteroid field/Legends|belt]] was connected by the [[Falko Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Arleen system/Legends|Arleen system]], while the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route known as the [[Cadma Conduit]] linked it to the [[Erilnar system/Legends|Erilnar system]] and the<ref name="TEA" /> [[Cadma sector/Legends|Cadma sector's]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Dagelin Minor system/Legends|Dagelin Minor system]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Sixth Belt contained [[Oseon 6845]], the largest orbital body of the Oseon system. It was an [[Iron/Legends|iron]]-based rock asteroid with a mass of a billion [[Metric ton/Legends|tons]] and a diameter of seven hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] that was also classified as a [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]]. The rotation period of Oseon 6845 was artificially shortened by its inhabitants to twenty-five [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] in order to help provide them with a familiar sense of [[Local day/Legends|day]] and night.<ref name="LCFO" />

===The Flamewind of Oseon===
{{Quote|As you probably are aware, it is perilous in the extreme, and also illegal, for ships to travel from asteroid to asteroid in the Oseon during Flamewind.|Administrator Senior Lob Doluff, to Lando Calrissian|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
Once per each [[local year]], every orbital body in the Oseon system, including those in the Sixth Belt, was affected by a phenomenon known as the [[Flamewind of Oseon/Legends|Flamewind]]. Caused by the [[Solar flare/Legends|flares]] of the Oseon [[Star/Legends|sun]] tearing excited vapor from the closest asteroids, the Flamewind manifested itself as fluorescent and multi-[[Color/Legends|colored]] bands of ionized [[Gas/Legends|gas]] millions of kilometers long and wide that continuously shifted across the entire [[Spectrum/Legends|spectrum]] of visible light.<ref name="LCFO" />

Accompanying the visual display were frequent static discharges between the system's asteroids and a constant barrage of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] and particles, such as [[Electron/Legends|electrons]]. As a result, navigational, [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]], and [[Life support/Legends|life-support]] equipment of inadequately [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielded]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] was damaged, electronic communications between the asteroids and with the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] were made impossible, and the perception and behavior of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings who were not appropriately protected was affected.<ref name="LCFO" />

==History==
===Bait for a gambler===
{{Quote|My associates and I, a small group of fanciers of the game, would like to invite you here at your convenience, to play with us.|Message from Administrator Senior Lob Doluff to Lando Calrissian|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
[[File:RokurGeptaCloseup-NEGTC.png|thumb|right|300px|Rokur Gepta (pictured) lured Lando Calrissian to the Oseon system.]]
At some point between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] novel trilogy, including ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].</ref> the [[Sorcerers of Tund/Legends|sorcerer]] [[Rokur Gepta]] planned to exact vengeance upon the [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] and [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. To that end, Gepta arranged for [[Lob Doluff]], the [[Administrator Senior]] of the Oseon system, to send a message to Calrissian on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dilonexa XXIII]], inviting the gambler to come play the [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] card game on the Sixth Belt asteroid Oseon 6845. Jumping at the potentially lucrative opportunity, the captain and his [[Pilot/Legends|copilot]], the [[Class Two multi-phasic robot|droid]] [[Vuffi Raa]], departed the [[Dilonexa system/Legends|Dilonexa system]] for the Oseon system.<ref name="LCFO" />

However, while Calrissian's [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], was still being [[Fuel/Legends|refueled]] on Dilonexa XXIII, one of Gepta's agents planted a pair of [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]] on the [[Light freighter/Legends|vessel]]. The first of the explosives detonated when the starship's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] was engaged several [[Standard day/Legends|days]] before its arrival in the Oseon. The second bomb exploded upon the ''Falcon'' reverting from hyperspace to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] near Oseon 6845, but the vessel emerged relatively unscathed due to the explosive being designed to destroy a ship entering the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] of a planet as opposed to an airless asteroid. Vuffi Raa subsequently oversaw the ''Falcon''{{'s}} setting down on the surface of Oseon 6845 in what was the inexperienced Calrissian's first starship landing under the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] piloting tutelage.<ref name="LCFO" />

===Complications on Oseon 6845===
{{Quote|Well, sir, the false alarm seems to have been intended as a trap. Someone ambushed me as I was preparing to return to the sabacc game&mdash;a stranger. I'm rather afraid I've killed him, Administrator Senior.|Lando Calrissian, to Administrator Senior Lob Doluff|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
[[File:VuffiNew.png|thumb|left|300px|Vuffi Raa, who was targeted in the Sixth Belt by the Renatasian Confederation.]]
On Calrissian's fourth night in the Sixth Belt, the gambler was playing sabacc with Lob Doluff and his associates at the Administrator Senior's Oseon 6845 [[Doluff's estate|estate]] when the former was lured to the asteroid's [[north polar spaceport]] with a false alarm about the ''Millennium Falcon''. There, Calrissian was ambushed by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Kenow]], a member of<ref name="LCFO" /> the [[Renatasian Confederation]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>&mdash;a [[Renatasian|group]] devoted to exacting vengeance upon Vuffi Raa, whom it wrongfully held responsible for the [[Battle of Renatasia|subjugation]] of the [[Renatasia system/Legends|Renatasia system]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Acting in self-defense, Calrissian [[Death/Legends|killed]] Kenow with his [[Stingbeam/Legends|stingbeam]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistol]], and, after informing Doluff of the incident, the gambler was placed under arrest.<ref name="LCFO" />

A few hours after Calrissian's arrest, while the gambler was still [[Prisoner/Legends|incarcerated]] in a local [[Prison/Legends|prison]] cell, the Flamewind phenomenon commenced in the Oseon system. By that [[Time/Legends|time]], Rokur Gepta had arrived at Oseon 6845 on his personal [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], the ''[[Wennis]]'', in pursuit of the ''Millennium Falcon''. Gepta arranged for Imperial authorities to order the arrest of [[Bohhuah Mutdah/Legends|Bohhuah Mutdah]], a retired trillionaire industrialist and the wealthiest individual in the Oseon system, though making it appear as if Mutdah's business rivals were having him arrested to plot his downfall.<ref name="LCFO" />

To that end, the Imperial undercover [[Spice/Legends|narcotics]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Waywa Fybot]] was dispatched to the Oseon system to make the arrest. As an added insurance, Doluff was pressured to ensure that the arrest went through. Gepta himself spent the time that followed Calrissian's arrest [[Meditation/Legends|meditating]] on Oseon 6845, while the ''Wennis'' was stationed some distance away with its crew performing a series of drill exercises. Also stationed at that time in the asteroid's shadow, at a distance of several thousand kilometers from it, was the [[Zero Squadron|squadron]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] constituting the Renatasian Confederation.<ref name="LCFO" />

===An execution averted===
{{Quote|We're off the ground and headed toward the Fifth Belt.|Lando Calrissian, to Waywa Fybot and Bassi Vobah|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
[[File:Lando-FlamewindCover.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Lando Calrissian during his visit in the Oseon system]]
Doluff eventually ordered Calrissian to be brought to his [[Administrator Senior's office|office]]. The Administrator Senior explained to the gambler that he was charged with carrying a lethal weapon, which was a capital offense in the Oseon system. However, the traditional Oseoni sentence, death by [[Spacing/Legends|exposure]] to the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of interplanetary space, would be exchanged for Calrissian being forced to participate in a sting operation. The gambler was to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] Fybot and [[Oseon Peacekeeper]] Captain [[Bassi Vobah]] to [[Oseon 5792]], Mutdah's private asteroid in the [[Fifth Belt]] of the system&mdash;a trip made extremely hazardous by to the ongoing Flamewind. At his destination, Calrissian would pose as a [[Courier/Legends|courier]] delivering Mutdah his scheduled supply of the illegal [[Lesai/Legends|lesai]] drug, allowing the two [[Police officer/Legends|law enforcement officers]] to arrest the trillionaire.<ref name="LCFO" />

Shortly thereafter, Calrissian's freighter left Oseon 6845. Alerted by a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] sent as a signal by the [[Unidentified first officer (Wennis)|first officer]] of the ''Wennis'', who was colluding with the Renatasian Confederation, the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] also departed the asteroid in pursuit of Calrissian's vessel. Eventually, Gepta, too, left Oseon 6845 aboard his [[Rokur Gepta's starfighter|personal starfighter]], leaving his cruiser behind and instructing it to rendezvous with him in the [[Tund system/Legends|Tund system]] after the Flamewind had passed. Gepta traveled to Oseon 5792, where he had Mutdah murdered and then assumed his appearance in order to entrap Calrissian.<ref name="LCFO" />

===Traveling during the Flamewind===
{{Quote|I'm having a wonderful time, wish you were here. I&mdash;''by the Galaxy Itself''! Hold on, I'll get back to you if we live!|Lando Calrissian, to Vuffi Raa|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
Since the navigational equipment of the ''Millennium Falcon'' was disabled by the Flamewind, Calrissian and Vuffi Raa had to rely on the ship following a [[Dead-reckoning program|pre-programmed]] course to Oseon 5792, a journey that would have only taken slightly more than two hours at any other time of the year. Due to the effects of the Flamewind, however, the ''Falcon''{{'s}} instrument readouts indicated that the vessel was, in order, traveling along a figure eight&ndash;shaped trajectory while spinning like a top; flying in a spiral and then in right triangles; and finally traveling along a path that corresponded to a line on the inside of a [[Klein bottle]]. Accompanying the disorienting sensor readouts were the Flamewind's changing displays of color and phases of different radiation fluxes that all affected the ''Falcon''{{'s}} crew and passengers.<ref name="LCFO" />

[[File:MillenniumFalcon-FlamewindOfOseon.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Lando Calrissian's freighter, the ''Millennium Falcon'', was attacked while traveling through the Sixth Belt.]]
When the Flamewind shifted to a red hue, the Renatasian Confederation caught up with the ''Falcon'' and [[Space warfare/Legends|attacked]] it. Detaching their two dozen starfighters from the hyperdrive [[Engine/Legends|engine]] of a<ref name="LCFO" /> [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> that the squadron was collectively using for faster-than-light travel, the Renatasians opened fire on the ''Falcon'', which forced Calrissian to disengage the [[Computer/Legends|computer]]-controlled pre-[[Programmer/Legends|programmed]] flight toward Oseon 5792 in order to perform evasive maneuvers.<ref name="LCFO" />

Calrissian managed to destroy two of the attacking craft, but another fighter then rammed the ''Falcon''{{'s}} bottom [[Hull/Legends|hull]], and the freighter's captain realized he could not prevail in the engagement. Orienting the vessel parallel to the ecliptic of the Oseon system, Calrissian fully engaged the ship's [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]] and outraced the squadron of attackers.<ref name="LCFO" />

As the ''Falcon'' left the Sixth Belt and entered the gap between it and the Fifth Belt, the intensity of the Flamewind's visual displays momentarily decreased, although Calrissian&mdash;a relatively inexperienced pilot and [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]]&mdash;was initially not sure whether the ship was, in fact, traveling inward or outward from the Sixth Belt. The ''Falcon'' then briefly hid in a small cluster of asteroids that followed its own course through the gap before continuing its journey toward Oseon 5792. There, Calrissian was later forced to briefly re-experience a distorted memory of the skirmish against the Renatasian fighters in the Sixth Belt when Gepta used the [[Mind trick/Legends|illusion-casting]] technique known as [[Memory Walk|torture by chagrin]] on him.<ref name="LCFO" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''[&hellip;]'' I assure you that no one you played with, excepting Miss Vobah here, who was appropriately subsidized, will miss so much as a micro of your winnings. We are a wealthy people.|Administrator Senior Lob Doluff, to Lando Calrissian|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
The government of the Oseon system, the [[Oseon Administration]], was based on the Sixth Belt asteroid Oseon 6845. It was headed by the Administrator Senior and employed the Oseon Peacekeepers as a local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] force. The Administration enforced the laws of the star system, such as the one forbidding the carrying of a lethal weapon, for which the sentence upon conviction was death by exposure to the vacuum of space.<ref name="LCFO" />

The entire Oseon system was inhabited by individuals of notable wealth. With that in mind, most of the establishments on Oseon 6845 were geared toward catering to affluent locals as well as attracting tourists from at least a million other systems of the wider [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. It was sometimes said that some among the pedestrians walking along the asteroid's throughway known as the [[Esplanade]] were the wealthiest individuals in the [[Universe/Legends|known universe]].<ref name="LCFO" />

Among the patrons of Oseon 6845's locales were [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]&ndash;speaking [[Human/Legends|Humans]] as well as members of a variety of other [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] and [[Alien/Legends|nonhuman]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Certain labels in public locations on Oseon 6845 were written in six [[Language/Legends|languages]].<ref name="LCFO" />

==Locations==
{{Main|Oseon 6845}}
The surface of the Sixth Belt asteroid Oseon 6845<ref name="LCFO" /> was entirely covered by [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclubs]] and resorts,<ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> and its interior was also filled with luxurious [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]], night entertainment venues, and palace-like residences. In addition, the Esplanade, a kilometers-long, domed pedestrian thoroughfare that constituted the center of a [[Unidentified city (Oseon 6845)|small city]],<ref name="LCFO" /> stretched around Oseon 6845's equator.<ref name="Gamer">{{GamerCite|5|A Campaign Guide to the Centrality}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Flamewind_of_Oseon_Cover.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Sixth Belt was introduced in ''Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon''.]]
The Sixth Belt was introduced in ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', the [[1983]] second entry in [[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] trilogy of novels by [[L. Neil Smith]]. On the original cover of the novel, an illustration by [[William Schmidt]] depicted several buildings on the Sixth Belt asteroid Oseon 6845.<ref name="LCFO" />

"[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] source article published in [[Voyages SF 13|''Voyages SF'' 13]], placed the Oseon system, and therefore the Sixth Belt, in the [[Zebitrope sector]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process, its [[canon]]icity within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity was never confirmed.<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently overrode the ''Voyages SF'' 13 placement by establishing that the Oseon system was situated in grid square T-8 as part of the Centrality.<ref name="TEA" />
